    Gyaan Deepak ! Prajwalan

    ASK needs funds to build accommodation for 142 soul seekers and towards maintenance of the rooms, personnel and meals. These soul seekers will devote their lives towards attainment of Self-Realization.

    Global preaching

    It was only because of donations that Fulchand was able to travel around the world to spread the teachings of Shrimad Rajchandra. There is a dire need for this divine knowledge in every country in this world. Your support can help Fulchand spread Omniscient preaching that empowers transformation in lives globally, including those who are living in miserable conditions and get to eat only once in 3 to 4 days.

    Television Broadcast of Atma Sadhana Discourses

    Millions of viewers benefit from Fulchand’s discourses on television. These broadcasts are made possible only due to sponsors who want several lives to benefit from these teachings of Omniscient Gods. We appreciate your contribution tremendously

    Books Publication

    Fulchand has shared immense knowledge through 40 spiritual titles published and distributed with generous help from donors. Your contribution will help us print more copies of the books that are in high demand (including the Atma Siddhi Shastra) that are regularly distributed to aspirants for no charge, and also facilitate new publications. All books are available for free download on this website, and hard copies are available for free at Adhyatmik Sadhana Kendra Umarala.

    Social Welfare

    ASK also provides basic food grains, medical and educational aid to the needy so that they can worry less about their minimum requirements are can spend some time every day in listening to discourses and doing tattva vichaar.

    Animal Welfare

    Recently, Fulchand saw 6 cattle on the road that were abandoned by their owners as they had become too old to continue with farming work. They have slaved their entire lives and now are too weak and would have been poached by butchers in a day or two. ASK decided to adopt these cattle, keep them on our premises and feed them thrice a day until the end of their lives. They seem very relaxed at this new life where they’re not forced to toil and are fed and just allowed to be.
